+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+
+
+def _load_image_payload(image_path: str) -> str:
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        return base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")
+
+
+def extract_receipt_fields(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    image_b64 = _load_image_payload(image_path)
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Extract merchant, tax, total, and items from this receipt. Return JSON with keys merchant, tax, total, items. items must be a list of objects with name, quantity, and price when available."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": f"data:image/png;base64,{image_b64}"},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "text": {"format": {"type": "json_object"}},
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    output_text = ""
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                output_text += content.get("text", "")
+    if not output_text:
+        output_text = data.get("output_text", "")
+    if not output_text:
+        raise ValueError("No structured output returned by OpenAI API")
+    parsed = json.loads(output_text)
+    return {
+        "merchant": parsed.get("merchant"),
+        "tax": parsed.get("tax"),
+        "total": parsed.get("total"),
+        "items": parsed.get("items", []),
+    }
+
+
+__all__ = ["extract_receipt_fields"]
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _text_from_response(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    output = data.get("output", [])
+    parts = []
+    for item in output:
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                text = content.get("text")
+                if text:
+                    parts.append(text)
+    if parts:
+        return "".join(parts)
+    return data.get("output_text", "") or ""
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields(invoice_text: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    prompt = (
+        "Extract vendor, date, total, and line-item fields from the invoice text. "
+        "Return only valid JSON with keys vendor, date, total, and line_items. "
+        "line_items must be an array of objects with fields description, quantity, unit_price, and amount. "
+        "If a field is missing, use null for scalar fields and [] for line_items.\n\n"
+        f"Invoice text:\n{invoice_text}"
+    )
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [{"type": "input_text", "text": prompt}],
+            }
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    text = _text_from_response(data).strip()
+    if not text:
+        raise ValueError("Empty response from OpenAI API")
+    return json.loads(text)
+
*** End Patch
